headline: Day 23 usage reset announced
scope: Day 23 usage reset announced; eligible plans and usage windows were not specified.

announcement.text: Day 23/ Much requested iCloud Main & Calendar plugins. Just kidding, today is a reset. Still much requested though!
announcement.translation: 第 23 天：呼声很高的 iCloud 邮件与日历插件。开玩笑的，今天是重置日。不过大家确实期待已久！

timingSource.translation: 将在 PST 午夜前落地。

note: At posting time it was October 27 in US Pacific time. The countdown interprets midnight as the end of that day: October 28 at 08:00 UTC under literal PST (UTC-8), or 07:00 UTC if local PDT was intended. This is an estimated deadline, not a confirmed execution time. No completion confirmation was found in the posts reviewed.
